title: Existence of constant mean curvature surfaces with controlled topology in 3-manifolds
summary: We establish the existence of a non-trivial, branched immersion of a closed Riemann surface $Σ$ with constant mean curvature (CMC) $H$ into any closed, orientable 3-manifold $\mathcal{M}$, for almost every prescribed value of $H$. The genus of the surface $Σ$ is bounded from above by the Heegaard genus $h$ of $\mathcal{M}$.
